summary: Local couple ski touring with their dog on closed Vail Mountain, defying the uphill-travel ban, had an accident at the top of Born Free; the wife broke her leg; after ski patrol didn't answer, the husband dialed 911; a half-dozen VMRG volunteers responded (fall/injury, 1 victim, Eagle; Vail Mountain Rescue Group). DATE APPROXIMATE — the essay places this mission around the April-6 Meadow Mountain mission ('our second mission in two days'); exact day unstated; source: Ted Katauskas 5280 'Viral Overload' essay, parent-opened this run.
notes: Run-658 VMRG chunk; date approximate per essay sequencing; curation pass may refine.
